title: FrameworkReceptor
description: Framework base Archetype for Receptor — a Structure's inbound causal port. Inherits gsm/Receptor through the top-level $ref and composes the catalogue-wide FrameworkAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Receptor statement distributed by this repository MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Receptor, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: gsm-frameworks (framework foundation).
